title: רב עוירא

paragraphs: (a) Pesaḥim 110b: dismissing the assemblies. Rashi on Ḥullin 51a explains that he brought students into and out of the study house. Before Rabbi Rabbah—Rashi: R. Yehudah HaNasi—with Rav Huna of Tzippori and R. Yose of Medea seated there, a needle in the thick reticulum was brought, and Rabbi turned it, etc., Ḥullin 51a. Rav Avira related this on arriving from the Land before Rav Safra and Abaye. Yuḥasin, under Rav Huna of Tzippori, disputes Rashi: how could he be before Rabbi and Abaye and Rav Safra? Rabbi Rabbah means the generation's great sage. End of quotation. Yet Ḥullin 54a says Rav served Rabbi Rabbah and R. Ḥiyya; Rashi does not explain there, since it must mean R. Yehudah HaNasi. Ketubbot 112a has R. Avira, R. Ḥelbo and R. Yose bar Ḥanina visit a place. R. Yose was R. Yoḥanan's student, and R. Yoḥanan lived in Rabbi's time; perhaps Avira lived long, or there were two.

(b) Rav Avira in Rava's name, Ḥullin 55a; Bava Batra 131b. Rav Adda before Rava in Rav Avira's name, Menaḥot 43a. Rav Avira expounded—some say R. Yehoshua ben Levi—Sukkah 52a. He expounded sometimes in Rav’s name, sometimes Rav Ashi’s, in Heilprin’s reading of Pesaḥim 119b. Perhaps this caused She'erit Yosef to list him among Rav's students. But Ein Yaakov and the checked Bavli read sometimes R. Ammi, sometimes R. Assi, as Berakhot 20b; Sotah 4b; Ḥullin 84b; two expositions in Gittin 7a. Pesaḥim thus has a scribal error, and She'erit Yosef erred.

Ulla was called Ulla Rabbah, Ketubbot 65b; Kiddushin 31a; R. Ulla the elder, Gittin 1; Ulla Naḥota, Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3. He went up from Babylonia to the Land, Nedarim 22. Rav Ḥisda cites “our teachers who descend,” namely Ulla, who reports in R. Yoḥanan’s name (Berakhot 38b). On coming he said the West had sanctified the month, Rosh HaShanah 22b. R. Abba told Rav Ashi they said thus in the West in R. Ulla's name, Bava Kamma 27b. Rav Ulla expounded, Shabbat 31b. In Babylonia he saw a basket of dates for a zuz: a basket of honey so cheap, yet Babylonians do not study Torah! At night they distressed him, etc. He saw flying clouds, predicted rain, but none came; as Babylonians lie, so their rains lie, Ta'anit 9b. At Pumbedita he saw rabbis shake their cloaks and called it Sabbath desecration; Rav Yehudah told them to shake them before him, Shabbat 147a. R. Yehudah asked his son Rav Yitzḥak to take Ulla fruit and observe his havdalah. He did not go, so Abaye was sent, Pesaḥim 104b. This requires examination: Abaye was Rava's age, Rava born when Rav Yehudah died. How could Abaye be old enough during Rav Yehudah's life to observe havdalah? A minor's testimony is not accepted even at ten; see R. Elazar son of R. Tzadok. Ulla refused to inspect blood at Pumbedita out of respect for its master Rav Yehudah, Niddah 20b.

Ulla gave priestly gifts to a priest's daughter. Rava objected; Ulla answered, “My teacher, your own argument makes my point” [מטונך, as explained by Rashi] etc., Ḥullin 131b–132a; Tosafot Zevaḥim 34b. Rif and Asheri read: when Ulla came he said to give the gifts to a priest's daughter. Nazir 51a likewise has Rava object. This suggests Ulla was Rava's teacher; how then call him 'My teacher'? Rav Ḥisda taught Rava and called Ulla our teacher who descends; this requires examination. Rabbah, Rava's teacher, reported Ulla and sat before him as student. Yalta, Rav Naḥman's wife, sent him words about itinerants because he withheld the blessing cup; see her entry. Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak says Ulla fixed his mistaken view like R. Binyamin bar Yefet, Berakhot 38b. Ulla rode with R. Abba at his right and Rabbah bar bar Ḥana left; R. Abba asked about his report in R. Yoḥanan's name, Pesaḥim 53b. R. Abba objected; Ulla told R. Abba, 'This rabbi resembles,' etc. He saw Rabbah bar bar Ḥana seated in water, Shabbat 157b; our reading is Rabbah son of Rav Huna. Ulla calls Rav Huna's statement vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, preferring the student's—R. Yirmeyah bar Abba—Kiddushin 45b. Ta'anit 4b applies this criticism to Rav Ḥisda. He wished for Rav and Shemuel's dust to fill his eyes, Ḥullin 68. Rabbah and Rav Yosef sat behind R. Zeira, R. Zeira before Ulla, Pesaḥim 37b. Ulla interpreted; R. Afes likewise said, Yoma 61a. Eruvin 55b places Ulla's explanation before R. Yoḥanan's; why before his teacher requires examination. He died outside the Land and was buried in it, Ketubbot 111a.

R. Abba objected; see above. R. Abba bar Kahana; R. Assi in his name. Abaye (see above). Avimi bar Pappa. R. Oshaya said, Ḥullin 76a; Rav Hoshaya objected to Ulla, Zevaḥim 32b. Rav Aḥa bar Adda in his name. R. Elazar his teacher, Tosafot Ḥullin 34a; in R. Elazar's name, several laws, Bava Kamma 11a,b; Eruvin 21b; Ketubbot 74a. R. Assi in his name (see above). R. Assi bar Hini. Rav Ashi told Rabbah, 'But Ulla said.' Bata. R. Dostai of Biri raised a contradiction. Rav Huna (see above); Rav Huna bar Ḥiyya in his name. Rav Hamnuna before him; R. Zeira before him. Ben Zakkai said; R. Zeira. R. Ḥagga in his name; R. Ḥiyya bar Abba and R. Ḥiyya bar Ammi in his name. R. Ḥiyya bar Assi—requires examination. Rav Ḥana bar Ḥanilai. R. Ḥanina said, Menaḥot 30b. Rav Ḥisda (see above) asked Ulla who heeded his teacher R. Yoḥanan. Rav Yehudah spoke to him, Ḥullin 68b; Ulla to Rav Yehudah, 76a. Rav Yehudah in his name, Avodah Zarah 40a; Rav Yehudah bar Ammi in his name. R. Yehoshua ben Levi said, Ḥullin 122a. Rav Yehoshua bar Abba in his name. R. Yoḥanan said, Eruvin 67b. He saw Rav Yitzḥak son of Rav grown and unmarried; see above. Rav in his name. Rav Kahana, Rosh HaShanah 22b. Before Rabbi Mana, beginning of Shekalim. Rav Menashe in his time. Rav Naḥman objected and called him Mar. Ulla bar Abba in his name. Rav Amram heard him. In bar Peda's name. Before ben Pazi, Ḥullin 46a. Rav said, Shabbat 143b. Rava bar Ulla, perhaps his son. Rava objected (see above). Rabbah son of Rav Huna (see above). Rabbah bar bar Ḥana his colleague, Tosafot Ḥullin 34a. Rabbah said: Ulla said, Me'ilah 3b; Yoma 54a; Rabbah told him the difficulty applied to him, Pesaḥim 93b. Ravin bar Ḥinena in his name. In R. Shimon ben Yehotzadak's name. Resh Lakish said, Pesaḥim 56b; Ḥagigah 8b; Bava Metzia 101a; Zevaḥim 32b. He visited Rav Shemuel bar Yehudah's house.
